role: Scientific modeling, language engineering and automation environment
maturity: Experimental alpha; Python-hosted workflow with a partial native compiler slice.

layers.name: Experience
layers.responsibility: CLI, GUI, portal, operator workflows; no business rules here.

layers.name: Interface contracts
layers.responsibility: Public APIs, commands, schemas, ABI, events and versioned message formats.

layers.name: Application orchestration
layers.responsibility: Use cases, workflows, sequencing, retries and transaction boundaries.

layers.name: Domain kernel
layers.responsibility: Core models, invariants, algorithms and deterministic business logic.

layers.name: Policy and capability
layers.responsibility: Authorization, safety gates, resource limits, maturity and allowed-operation policy.

layers.name: Ports and contracts
layers.responsibility: Abstract clocks, storage, device, network, filesystem, compiler and platform interfaces.

layers.name: Adapters and platform
layers.responsibility: Concrete OS, board, browser, hardware, protocol and external-service implementations.

layers.name: State and data
layers.responsibility: Schemas, registries, persistence, caches, artifacts, migrations and provenance.

layers.name: Runtime and delivery
layers.responsibility: Processes, boot, packaging, deployment, build graph, configuration and operational lifecycle.

layers.name: Assurance and evidence
layers.responsibility: Unit/integration/system tests, static analysis, benchmarks, logs, attestations and qualification evidence.

vertical_slices.title: Source → static check
vertical_slices.path: CLI/IDE input → parser contract → AST and semantic domain → diagnostic policy → evidence-rich report.

vertical_slices.title: Source → compiler artifact
vertical_slices.path: Source → typed IR → validated lowering → backend adapter → artifact; unsupported stages must fail explicitly, never fabricate completion.

vertical_slices.title: Scientific workflow
vertical_slices.path: Versioned model input → dimensional validation → deterministic calculation/sampling → persisted result and reproducibility metadata.

guardrails: Do not label SAMBU a complete native compiler, universal sandbox, operating system or unrestricted automation runtime. A declaration, preview or planned backend is not evidence of execution. Keep host process/device/network access behind explicit adapters and authorization.
status_note: This map is an architecture contract, not proof that every mapped capability is implemented. Verify each claim against source, tests and target evidence.
